price.description: Price per unit with 7 decimal precision

destination.description: Message destination type for single recipient

msisdn.title: PhoneNumber
msisdn.description: Phone number in international format without + sign. Required for destination=phone/otp. Must be 8-15 digits starting with country code

reference.title: MessageReference
reference.description: External reference ID for tracking message. Must be unique. Auto-generated if not provided. Only alphanumeric characters, hyphens and underscores allowed

originator.title: MessageSender
originator.description: Sender's name: from 3 to 11 characters for alphanumeric name (Latin letters, symbols, numbers, spaces); 3 to 15 characters for numeric name. Required field

body.title: SmsMessageText
body.example: Hello! This is a test message from BSG SMS Gateway.
